visual_action: A slideshow of three photographs. The first is a color portrait of a young Kamala Harris. The second is a color portrait of a young Douglas Emhoff. The third is a black-and-white photo of Harris and Emhoff as an adult couple, smiling at each other while Emhoff adjusts something on Harris's suit. Animated pink heart emojis float above them in the final image.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: A youthful portrait of her is shown, followed by a photo of her as an adult with her husband.

cast.name: Douglas Emhoff
cast.evidence: A youthful portrait of him is shown, followed by a photo of him as an adult with his wife.

on_screen_text.text: Who will I marry one day??

audio_music: A gentle, romantic instrumental track plays throughout the video, identified as 'Noisy Ringing feat. junamaki kui ma na ju' by VICTOR SAINT.

cultural_references: The video employs a common social media trend format showing past and present photos to tell a story, in this case, a romantic one.
central_claim: The video portrays the relationship between Kamala Harris and Douglas Emhoff as a sweet and destined love story.
intended_effect: To humanize Kamala Harris by highlighting her personal life and relationship, and to evoke feelings of warmth and affection from the viewer.
